[[Forgotten Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] traded by the [[Keeper of Nature]], a [[collector]] in the [[Throne of Secrets]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Health]] +30 

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as a [[Ivory Bow]] [[dye]]d silver
